dash.caption: All key signals at a glance · Seasonality · Strategies · Risk · Events
dash.drawdown_title: Seasonal Drawdown · Avg vs. Current Year
home.demo_desc: Move the slider: the grey lines show individual years of the Dow Jones. As they merge, the golden seasonal chart emerges — the statistical average. The yellow line shows the current year in the Dow Jones.
home.tools_sub: Cycles, Events, Strategies — every time frame and market event reveals its own statistical patterns.
home.feat_decade_p: Up to 131 years of history. Cohorts by terminal digit. Anomaly Radar and drawdown analysis.
home.feat_year_p: Seasonal annual progression with presidential cycle, significance tests and percentile bands.
home.feat_month_p: Intra-month TDOM progression with de-trend indicator, heatmaps and cycle matching.
home.feat_weekday_p: Weekday performance, overnight vs. intraday, weekend effect and consecutive streak analysis.
home.feat_tom_p: Turn of the Month effect with streak analysis, window optimisation and ToM heatmap.
home.feat_moon_p: Full and new moon effect, supermoon comparison and lunar calendar.
home.feat_backtest_p: Walk-forward optimisation, grid search across time windows and AI-powered event relevance scoring. Validate every strategy before deploying it.
home.feat_vanilla_p: 24 rule-based seasonal strategies — from Sell in May to the Halloween Indicator. Equity curves, trade lists and performance metrics at the click of a button.
home.feat_risk_p: Seasonal drawdowns, rolling volatility and presidential cycle risk. When during the year do the largest pullbacks occur?
home.feat_opex_p: Options expiration (3rd Friday), Triple Witching and VIX settlement. Event windows, volatility and backtest.
home.feat_events_p: Fed, ECB, BoE, BoJ event windows. Holiday effects by exchange (NYSE, XETRA, LSE). Streak analysis and significance.
home.feat_dashboard_p: All signals at a glance: AI Score, Crash Signal, Anomaly Radar, Strategies, Risk KPIs and event calendar — in one bento grid.
home.ai_sub: Statistical testing, pattern recognition and machine learning — every feature delivers real analytical value.
home.ai_ki_p: 5 sub-scores → one overall grade 0–10. Pattern path, trend, win rate, tracking and seasonal strength — at a glance.
home.ai_truepath_p: Finds the most similar historical years via correlation and projects their weighted progression into the future.
home.ai_anomaly_p: Z-score + percentile rank of the last 10 trading days. Detects deviations from the seasonal pattern in real time.
home.ai_backtest_p: Grid search and walk-forward for 24 strategies. Out-of-sample validation protects against overfitting.
home.ai_sig_p: t-test and Cohen's d for every result. Radial gauges show at a glance whether a pattern is statistically robust.
home.ai_outlier_p: IQR detection, winsorize and Isolation Forest. Filter extreme years — configurable threshold on every page.
home.ai_indicator_p: SMA, EMA, RSI, Bollinger, MACD and LBR as AND-combined filters. Seasonality meets technical analysis.
home.ai_scanner_p: 270+ tickers automatically scanned. Weekly cron job delivers AI scores, win rates and seasonal signals at a glance.
